issues: Unfixed direction error: report says absolute benefit would expand if off-treatment effect ceased, contradicting source PMC7616743, which says it would diminish while observed maintained (CLM-020).
CLM-013 supportQuote lacks the numeric facts it backs (4891/6609, 43% vs 40%); numbers are real but not bonded to the cited quote.
Internal inconsistency: audit says 32 claims all passed, later revision notes reference 37 claims and known defects; run.json says succeeded though delivery is partial.
Report calls hard-event and eGFR-slope evidence lines 'mutually independent' despite both originating from the same randomized population, an overstatement.
Known unresolved GRADE self-consistency gate issues and an unaccounted correction-forward for PMID 38061371 mean the audit's 'no corrections' statement is unreliable.
judge.rationale: The answer is detailed and mostly respects one-study vs three-reports and randomized vs post-trial distinctions, but the delivery documents unfixed errors, including a central source contradiction on absolute-benefit direction and a mis-mounted evidential quote. These undermine correctness and trust; evidence handling is only partially bonded. Safety framing remains cautious and evidence-level, so it scores moderately.
